levels.name: Jungle clear
levels.rules:
## Clear the jungle as fast as possible.

- You need to kill all 6 camps on your side of the jungle.
- You must be alone on your team, while the opposing team must be empty.
- Timing ends when the final blow is dealt to the last camp.

### Modes:

- Custom games and Practice Tool are both allowed. 
- If using practice tool, the only usable commands are "**Fast Forward**", "**Set Game Speed to 1x/2x**" and "**Reset Game**", all other commands are banned;
- Time related runes are banned if "**Reset Game**" command is used (gathering storm, conditioning etc)
- Champion HUD and inventory must be shown.

### Summoner Spells:

- You can't use summoner spells other than smite.

### Runes:

- Must show champion's pick rate in jungle via u.gg (All ranks, Plat+, or Emerald+) (**proof required**). 
- If the champion's pick rate is below 0.5%, you are free to use any rune.
- If the champion's pick rate is above 0.5%, your runes need to be based on the rune table found on u.gg, a minimum of 10% pick rate is required (**proof required**).
- If a rune doesn't affect the clear at all, it can be taken freely (champ related runes like conqueror etc). 
- The first 2 days of a patch will use last patch's runes, as there's insufficient data.

values.name: Any%
values.rules:
Win on each map back to back (from Warehouse District to The Beachhead (o particular order)).

Timer starts on map load (stops when the boss is killed) and the run ends when the last boss is dead (the time that takes to chose a card is added into the final time, but the queue up and loadingscreen for the next map isn't). All games must be played on the same session and recording - sending more than one video (unless its justified) will be an automatic rejection. Splicing runs is also not allowed.

The calculation for the final time is the following:

- Rek'Sai killing time + Briar killing time + Bel'Veth killing time + Aatrox killing time = Final Time

You are not required to do this calculation, a mod or verifier will do it for you.

Any difficulty can be picked, but it can't be changed in between maps. For example, if you began playing Warehouse District in Story mode you can not switch to The Outskirts in Hard.

Win on each map and each difficulty back to back (from Warehouse District (Story) to The Beachhead (Extreme)).

Timer starts on first map load and ends when Aatrox is killed. You can take a break after finishing a difficulty (winning every map in Story mode for example), but the timer can not stop running.

levels.name: Jungle clear
levels.rules:
## Clear the jungle as fast as possible.

- You need to kill all 6 camps on your side of the jungle.
- You must be alone on your team, while the opposing team must be empty.
- Timing ends when the final blow is dealt to the last camp.

### Modes:

- Custom games and Practice Tool are both allowed. 
- If using practice tool, the only usable commands are "**Fast Forward**", "**Set Game Speed to 1x/2x**" and "**Reset Game**", all other commands are banned;
- Time related runes are banned if "**Reset Game**" command is used (gathering storm, conditioning etc)
- Champion HUD and inventory must be shown.

### Summoner Spells:

- You can't use summoner spells other than smite.

### Runes:

- Must show champion's pick rate in jungle via u.gg (All ranks, Plat+, or Emerald+) (**proof required**). 
- If the champion's pick rate is below 0.5%, you are free to use any rune.
- If the champion's pick rate is above 0.5%, your runes need to be based on the rune table found on u.gg, a minimum of 10% pick rate is required (**proof required**).
- If a rune doesn't affect the clear at all, it can be taken freely (champ related runes like conqueror etc). 
- The first 2 days of a patch will use last patch's runes, as there's insufficient data.

values.name: Any%
values.rules:
Win on each map back to back (from Warehouse District to The Beachhead (o particular order)).

Timer starts on map load (stops when the boss is killed) and the run ends when the last boss is dead (the time that takes to chose a card is added into the final time, but the queue up and loadingscreen for the next map isn't). All games must be played on the same session and recording - sending more than one video (unless its justified) will be an automatic rejection. Splicing runs is also not allowed.

The calculation for the final time is the following:

- Rek'Sai killing time + Briar killing time + Bel'Veth killing time + Aatrox killing time = Final Time

You are not required to do this calculation, a mod or verifier will do it for you.

Any difficulty can be picked, but it can't be changed in between maps. For example, if you began playing Warehouse District in Story mode you can not switch to The Outskirts in Hard.

Win on each map and each difficulty back to back (from Warehouse District (Story) to The Beachhead (Extreme)).

Timer starts on first map load and ends when Aatrox is killed. You can take a break after finishing a difficulty (winning every map in Story mode for example), but the timer can not stop running.
